title: Constant algebraic normalization is sourcewise universal
statement: For a scheme Y and any normalized algebraic quotient tower T [def-weil-pbc-finite-perfect-adic-tower-data], each explicitly constructed finitePerfectAdicEtaleConstantTransition Y T n [def-weil-pbc-finite-perfect-adic-constant-normalization] satisfies EtaleUniversalNormalization [def-weil-pbc-etale-universal-normalization] for the lifted consecutive quotient homomorphism. Thus its actual source arrows are universal and satisfy the canonical restriction coherence. This constructs no actual quotient, realization, Isom-presheaf map or covering.

lean.statement:
theorem finitePerfectAdicEtaleConstant_normalization (Y : Scheme.{t})
    {A : Type t} [CommRing A] {d : AdicCoefficientDatum A}
    (T : FinitePerfectAdicAlgebraTower d) (n : ℕ) :
    EtaleUniversalNormalization Y
      (RingHom.ulift (Ideal.Quotient.factorPowSucc d.ideal (n + 1)))
      (finitePerfectAdicEtaleConstantTransition Y T n)
